name: The Good News According to Luke

verses.text: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

He said to them, “\+w When \+w you \+w pray \+w say ‘\+w Our \+w Father \+w in heaven,* \+w may \+w your \+w name \+w be kept holy.* \+w May \+w your Kingdom \+w come \+w May \+w your \+w will \+w be done \+w on earth, \+w as \+w it \+w is \+w in heaven.*
\+w Give \+w us \+w day \+w by \+w day \+w our \+w daily bread.*

Forgive \+w us \+w our sins,* \+w for \+w we \+w ourselves \+w also forgive \+w everyone \+w who \+w is \+w indebted \+w to \+w us * \+w Bring \+w us \+w not \+w into \+w temptation \+w but deliver \+w us \+w from \+w the \+w evil \+w one
He said to them, “\+w Which \+w of \+w you \+w if \+w you \+w go \+w to \+w a \+w friend \+w at \+w midnight \+w and \+w tell \+w him ‘\+w Friend \+w lend \+w me \+w three loaves \+w of bread, *

“\+w I \+w tell \+w you keep \+w asking \+w and \+w it \+w will \+w be \+w given \+w you Keep \+w seeking \+w and \+w you \+w will \+w find Keep \+w knocking \+w and \+w it \+w will \+w be opened \+w to \+w you *
\+w For \+w everyone \+w who asks \+w receives \+w He \+w who \+w seeks \+w finds \+w To \+w him \+w who \+w knocks \+w it \+w will \+w be opened.*

“\+w Which \+w of \+w you \+w fathers \+w if \+w your \+w son asks \+w for bread, \+w will \+w give \+w him \+w a \+w stone \+w Or \+w if \+w he asks \+w for \+w a \+w fish \+w he won’\+w t \+w give \+w him \+w a \+w snake \+w instead \+w of \+w a \+w fish \+w will \+w he *
\+w Or \+w if \+w he asks \+w for \+w an \+w egg \+w he won’t \+w give \+w him \+w a \+w scorpion \+w will \+w he *

\+w If \+w you \+w then \+w being \+w evil \+w know \+w how \+w to \+w give \+w good \+w gifts \+w to \+w your \+w children \+w how \+w much \+w more \+w will \+w your \+w heavenly \+w Father \+w give \+w the \+w Holy \+w Spirit \+w to \+w those \+w who ask \+w him
He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “\+w Every kingdom \+w divided \+w against \+w itself \+w is \+w brought \+w to desolation. \+w A \+w house \+w divided \+w against \+w itself \+w falls *
\+w If \+w Satan \+w also \+w is \+w divided \+w against \+w himself \+w how \+w will \+w his kingdom \+w stand \+w For \+w you \+w say \+w that \+w I \+w cast \+w out \+w demons \+w by Beelzebul. *
\+w But \+w if \+w I \+w cast \+w out \+w demons \+w by Beelzebul, \+w by \+w whom \+w do \+w your \+w children \+w cast \+w them \+w out \+w Therefore \+w they \+w will \+w be \+w your \+w judges *
\+w But \+w if \+w I \+w by \+w God \+w finger \+w cast \+w out \+w demons \+w then \+w God Kingdom \+w has \+w come \+w to \+w you
“\+w When \+w the \+w strong \+w man \+w fully \+w armed \+w guards \+w his \+w own dwelling, \+w his goods \+w are \+w safe *

“\+w He \+w who \+w is \+w not \+w with \+w me \+w is \+w against \+w me \+w He \+w who doesn’\+w t \+w gather \+w with \+w me \+w scatters

But he said, “\+w On \+w the \+w contrary \+w blessed \+w are \+w those \+w who hear \+w the \+w word \+w of \+w God \+w and \+w keep \+w it

When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “\+w This \+w is \+w an \+w evil \+w generation \+w It \+w seeks \+w after \+w a \+w sign \+w No \+w sign \+w will \+w be \+w given \+w to \+w it \+w but \+w the \+w sign \+w of \+w Jonah \+w the prophet. *

“\+w No \+w one \+w when \+w he \+w has lit \+w a \+w lamp \+w puts \+w it \+w in \+w a \+w cellar \+w or \+w under \+w a \+w basket \+w but \+w on \+w a stand, \+w that \+w those \+w who \+w come \+w in \+w may see \+w the \+w light *

\+w Therefore \+w see whether \+w the \+w light \+w that \+w is \+w in \+w you isn’\+w t \+w darkness *

\+w If \+w therefore \+w your \+w whole \+w body \+w is \+w full \+w of \+w light \+w having \+w no \+w part \+w dark \+w it \+w will \+w be \+w wholly \+w full \+w of \+w light \+w as \+w when \+w the \+w lamp \+w with \+w its \+w bright shining gives \+w you \+w light
Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

The Lord said to him, “\+w Now \+w you \+w Pharisees \+w cleanse \+w the \+w outside \+w of \+w the \+w cup \+w and \+w of \+w the \+w platter \+w but \+w your \+w inward \+w part \+w is \+w full \+w of extortion \+w and \+w wickedness *
\+w You \+w foolish ones, didn’\+w t \+w he \+w who \+w made \+w the \+w outside \+w make \+w the \+w inside \+w also *
\+w But \+w give \+w for \+w gifts \+w to \+w the needy \+w those \+w things \+w which \+w are \+w within \+w and \+w behold \+w all \+w things \+w will \+w be \+w clean \+w to \+w you *

\+w But \+w woe \+w to \+w you \+w Pharisees \+w For \+w you tithe \+w mint \+w and \+w rue \+w and \+w every \+w herb \+w but \+w you bypass \+w justice \+w and \+w God love. \+w You \+w ought \+w to \+w have \+w done \+w these \+w and \+w not \+w to \+w have \+w left \+w the \+w other undone. *
\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w Pharisees \+w For \+w you love \+w the best \+w seats \+w in \+w the \+w synagogues \+w and \+w the greetings \+w in \+w the marketplaces. *
\+w Woe \+w to \+w you scribes \+w and Pharisees, hypocrites! \+w For \+w you \+w are \+w like hidden \+w graves \+w and \+w the \+w men \+w who \+w walk \+w over \+w them don’\+w t \+w know \+w it
One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

He said, “\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w lawyers \+w also \+w For \+w you \+w load \+w men \+w with \+w burdens \+w that \+w are difficult \+w to carry, \+w and \+w you \+w yourselves won’\+w t \+w even lift \+w one \+w finger \+w to help carry \+w those \+w burdens *
\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w For \+w you \+w build \+w the \+w tombs \+w of \+w the \+w prophets \+w and \+w your \+w fathers killed \+w them *
\+w So \+w you \+w testify \+w and consent \+w to \+w the \+w works \+w of \+w your \+w fathers \+w For \+w they killed \+w them \+w and \+w you \+w build \+w their tombs. *

As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
